catalyst.caveat: Questionably Epic's staging conversion work models inherited stats and catalyst identity, but exact preservation of bonus IDs, special effects, gems, Speed, and other tertiary data has not been accepted for this tracker. Catalyst-derived rankings must remain pending until versioned fixtures verify the converted item identity and every carried stat or effect.
